_comment: Manual fishing map manifest. Edit this file directly to add, remove or update map spots. Coordinates are approximate map-pin locations derived from the supplied notes and map images, not navigation-grade positions.

spots.name: Knockadoon Area
spots.type: Area summary, headland, rock, beach and surf marks
spots.seasons: Year-round, strongest late spring to autumn; codling/coalfish in autumn and winter
spots.notes: Parent area for Knockadoon Head to Ballycotton marks. Productive but exposed in places; wear a lifejacket on rocks and watch surf, swell and access.

spots.name: Knockadoon Head
spots.seasons: Late spring to autumn; rough-ground species possible year-round
spots.notes: Track across the headland leads down to the mark. Spinning and float fishing for pollack, wrasse, mackerel and mullet; bottom fishing for conger and rockling.

spots.name: Old Signal Tower, Knockadoon Head
spots.type: Rock and weed ground with sandy patches
spots.seasons: Spring to winter depending on target species
spots.notes: Southern corner of Knockadoon Head below the old signal tower. Spinning and float fishing over mixed ground; bottom fishing can produce conger, cod and coalfish.

spots.name: Ballymakeragh Rocks
spots.type: Low rock and small headland mark
spots.seasons: Summer for bass and wrasse; late autumn for codling and coalfish
spots.notes: Eastern side of the small headland is noted as productive. Best baits include crab, lugworm, mackerel and squid.

spots.name: Ballycrenane Beach
spots.type: Long surf beach with mixed sand, rock and weed
spots.seasons: Spring and summer for lure bass; autumn/winter for bass, flounder and codling; summer for ray and flats
spots.notes: East end is rougher; west becomes cleaner sand. Bass on plugs/spinners near high water in spring/summer. Surf helps bass and flounder. Lugworm and sandeel can be dug on the beach.

spots.name: Ballinwilling Reef
spots.notes: Bottom fishing from the rocks at the seaward end; casting over sand gives best results. Crab can be collected near the car park area in summer.

spots.name: Ballinwilling Strand
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; codling possible in autumn
spots.notes: Bottom fishing in front of the car park and between the stream and marsh outflow. Crab, lugworm and mackerel are top baits.

spots.name: Garryvoe Strand
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; night tides can be strong in summer
spots.notes: Well-known specimen shore mark with strong tournament history. Best baits include lugworm, squid, crab and mackerel.

spots.name: Ardnahinch Strand
spots.type: Surf beach between Garryvoe and Shanagarry
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; night tides generally best in midsummer
spots.notes: Similar quality to Garryvoe and has produced specimen fish including painted ray. Lugworm can be dug near Shanagarry car park.

spots.name: Ballynamona Lagoon Entrance
spots.type: Beach, lagoon entrance and surf mark
spots.seasons: Autumn/winter for surf species; summer for occasional seatrout
spots.notes: Fish two hours either side of high water. Sensitive bird/wetland area; avoid disturbing roosting birds, especially in winter.

spots.name: Silver Strand, Ballycotton Approach
spots.type: Small beach with rocky southern end
spots.notes: Lane down to beach before Ballycotton. Southern rocky end has produced large conger; bass common on flood tide over sand.

spots.name: Ballycotton Harbour
spots.seasons: Year-round; charter season usually May to September; mullet in summer
spots.notes: Historic sea-angling location. Shore fishing from harbour/breakwater; mullet on float-fished fish strips in summer. Spring tides are about Cobh +00:11.

spots.name: Mine Head Area
spots.type: Area summary, surf beach, estuary, harbour and rock marks
spots.seasons: Year-round, with beach and rock species strongest from late spring to autumn
spots.notes: Parent area for Mine Head to Knockadoon Pier marks. Exposed open-coast and estuary fishing; choose marks based on wind, surf and tide.

spots.name: Ballyquinn Strand
spots.seasons: June to September best; also fishes in settled surf outside summer
spots.notes: Flooding tide into darkness is best. Crab, sandeel, mackerel and ragworm all take fish.

spots.name: Black Rocks
spots.seasons: Summer for mackerel; spring to autumn for bass and pollack
spots.notes: Plugging and spinning can produce bass and pollack; bottom fishing gives dogfish and occasional conger.

spots.name: Ardmore Beach
spots.notes: Popular beach by day, fishes best during darkness. Lugworm can be dug north of the car park.

spots.name: Ardmore Pier
spots.seasons: Year-round; boat/wreck species best in settled weather
spots.notes: Pier bottom fishing for bass, flats, ray and dogfish; spinning for seatrout and mackerel. Small boats can access mixed ground and wrecks.

spots.name: Ardmore Head
spots.notes: Spinning and float fishing from rocks. Watch swell and footing.

spots.name: Fr. O'Donnell's Well, Rams Head
spots.notes: One of the Rams Head rock marks. Float fish crab/ragworm for wrasse; squid or mackerel baits for occasional conger.

spots.name: Fallawaderra, Rams Head
spots.notes: Productive spinning/float mark on southern Rams Head.

spots.name: Fall an Iarann, Rams Head
spots.notes: Similar Rams Head rock fishing; only fish in safe settled conditions.

spots.name: Goat Island
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; mackerel in season
spots.notes: Bottom fishing produces bass, flats, dogfish and coalfish; high-water spinning can produce mackerel and occasional seatrout.

spots.name: Whiting Bay
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; surf conditions helpful
spots.notes: West side of the car park is cleaner with less stone and weed. Sandeel, crab and ragworm are best baits.

spots.name: Calliso Bay
spots.type: Small surf bay with mixed ends
spots.seasons: Late summer and autumn for spinning; surf conditions for bass/flounder
spots.notes: Crab or sandeel over sand; mixed sand and rock at eastern end for conger, wrasse and rockling.

spots.name: Mangan's Cove
spots.seasons: Summer for bass/ray/dogfish; autumn and winter for flounder/codling
spots.notes: Crab, sandeel and ragworm for summer species; lugworm and crab for flounder and codling.

spots.name: East Point to Monatrae House
spots.seasons: Summer for bass/dogfish/ray; autumn and winter for flounder/codling/eels
spots.notes: Cast 80 to 120 metres into the Blackwater channel where rough ground gives way to mud and sand.

spots.name: Ferry Point
spots.seasons: Year-round; codling/flounder winter and spring; bass/plaice/dogfish summer
spots.notes: Best from half flood through high water and two hours into the ebb. Slack low water can be good for flounder. Slipway can be slippery with weed.

spots.name: Old Bridge, Youghal
spots.notes: Bottom fishing two hours either side of high water with crab and worm baits; spinning can account for small pollack.

spots.name: Tourig River / Rincrew Bridge
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn for bass and seatrout; flats/eels by season
spots.notes: Spinning at high water for bass and seatrout; bottom fishing for flounder and eels.

spots.name: Youghal Dyke Wall
spots.seasons: Year-round; codling strongest in colder months
spots.notes: First-class fishing along the wall south of the old road landfall. Crab is the best bottom bait; spinning is worth trying for bass.

spots.name: Old Carpet Factory Pier, Youghal
spots.notes: Continuation of the dyke wall stretch. Bottom fishing and occasional spinning for bass.

spots.name: Youghal Quays / Green Park Corner
spots.seasons: Year-round; night tides productive in midsummer
spots.notes: Shore fishing best on flooding tide. Crab, sandeel, mackerel and ragworm are good baits. Youghal tides are about Cobh +00:14.

spots.name: Youghal / Redbarn Strand
spots.seasons: Flood tides year-round; coalfish October to December
spots.notes: Best on flood tide with rolling surf. Busy beach in holiday periods, so night tides or off-peak periods are better.

spots.name: Pillmore Strand
spots.notes: Flooding tide produces bass, flounder and occasional plaice; spinning in the channel can produce seatrout. Lugworm available on channel banks.

spots.name: Pillmore Estuary
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; avoid weed-heavy spring tides
spots.notes: Spinning in the channel on a flood tide. Bottom-fished crab baits can take bass and flounder. Heavy floating weed on spring tides can be a problem.

spots.name: Ballymacoda Estuary South Side
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; night tides best
spots.notes: Fish arrive for a short period of about an hour around high water; crab or worm baits recommended.

spots.name: Knockadoon Pier / Capel Island Area
spots.type: Pier, harbour wall and small-boat area
spots.seasons: High tide for spinning; mackerel in season
spots.notes: Spinning at high tide for pollack and mackerel; float fishing for mullet. Small-boat fishing around Capel Island for codling, wrasse, pollack, conger and coalfish.

spots.name: Cork Harbour to Ballycotton Area
spots.type: Area summary, harbour, estuary, beach and rock marks
spots.seasons: Year-round, with harbour winter species and open-coast summer/autumn species
spots.notes: Parent area for Ram Point to Ballycotton marks. Includes sheltered harbour fishing and more exposed open-coast marks.

spots.name: Ram Point Strand
spots.notes: Spinning, float fishing and bottom fishing for bass; bottom fishing for ray and dogfish. Flood and ebb tide best.

spots.name: Camden
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for ray, bass and dogfish.

spots.name: Lough Beg
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for flounder, bass and mullet.

spots.name: Lough More
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for bass, flounder, plaice and occasional ray.

spots.name: Paddy's Point
spots.notes: Spinning for bass; bottom fishing for flounder, ray and dabs. Crab bait is productive.

spots.name: Monkstown Pier
spots.seasons: Year-round; codling and whiting November to February
spots.notes: Conger, small pollack and wrasse around the pier; bottom fishing for flounder and dabs.

spots.name: Cork Harbour Sea Wall
spots.seasons: Codling November to February; conger/ray/dabs/dogfish June to September
spots.notes: Seasonal bottom fishing from the sea wall.

spots.name: Deepwater Quay
spots.seasons: Year-round with winter codling/whiting and summer ray/dogfish patterns
spots.notes: Best baits include crab, fish bait and mussel. Specimen flounder, dab, whiting and three-bearded rockling recorded.

spots.name: Lynch's Quay
spots.seasons: Codling/dabs/coalfish November to February; flounder/dogfish/ray in summer
spots.notes: Seasonal bottom fishing from the quay.

spots.name: East Ferry Mouth
spots.notes: Spinning for bass; bottom fishing for flounder, dogfish and excellent ray fishing.

spots.name: Brown Island
spots.notes: Crab and fish bait best. Start of flood tide is most productive for flatfish.

spots.name: Bawnard
spots.notes: Mullet and gilthead bream possible along with bass.

spots.name: Gold Point
spots.notes: Spinning for bass and seatrout at the slipway; bottom fishing for rays and dogfish. Specimen bass recorded.

spots.name: Saleen Estuary
spots.notes: Lugworm and crab can be gathered here.

spots.name: Rostellan Estuary
spots.notes: Lugworm and ragworm can be dug here.

spots.name: Lower Aghada Pier
spots.seasons: Year-round; conger at night; codling November to February
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for flats and dogfish; occasional winter codling; float fishing for mullet.

spots.name: Whitegate Bay
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for bass, gilthead bream, golden grey mullet and flounder.

spots.name: Corkbeg Strand
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for bass, dogfish, occasional ray and flounder.

spots.name: White Bay Rocks
spots.seasons: Late spring to autumn; mackerel in season
spots.notes: Spinning for bass, small pollack and mackerel from rocks.

spots.name: White Bay
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; surf improves fishing
spots.notes: Surf fishing for bass, flatfish, dogfish and occasional ray. Specimen plaice recorded.

spots.name: Canavan's Point
spots.notes: Float/lure fishing for bass; spinning for pollack and mackerel.

spots.name: Roche's Point
spots.seasons: Late spring to autumn; bottom species possible year-round
spots.notes: Spinning for bass, pollack and mackerel; bottom fishing for conger and rockling; float fishing for wrasse. Specimen bass and wrasse recorded.

spots.name: Trabolgan Strand
spots.notes: Surf fishing for bass, flatfish and dogfish.

spots.name: Guileen
spots.notes: Lure, float and bottom fishing for bass, flatfish, wrasse and pollack.

spots.name: Inch
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for bass, flatfish and codling. Sandeel available in season; specimen bass and flounder recorded.

spots.name: Power Head
spots.seasons: Late spring to autumn; mackerel in season
spots.notes: Spinning and float fishing for mackerel, pollack and wrasse; bottom fishing for bass and flatfish.

spots.name: Ballybrannigan
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for bass and flatfish. Float and lure fishing for bass on the first quarter of the flood.

spots.name: Ballycroneen
spots.type: Surf beach and eastern rock mark
spots.notes: Surf fishing for bass and flounder; lure fishing for bass, pollack and mackerel from rocks on the eastern side.

spots.name: Ballylanders
spots.seasons: Late spring to autumn when accessible
spots.notes: Lure fishing for bass, pollack and mackerel; bait fishing for wrasse on crab baits. Reported inaccessible due to storm damage in the provided notes.

spots.name: Ballyandereen
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; codling/coalfish possible colder months
spots.notes: Spinning/float fishing for pollack and wrasse. Bottom fishing from the right side over sand for flounder, bass, codling and coalfish.

spots.name: Galley Head to Ballymacus Point Area
spots.type: Area summary, Atlantic rock, surf, estuary and harbour marks
spots.seasons: Spring to late autumn; some winter codling and estuary species
spots.notes: Parent area for the Galley Head to Ballymacus Point map. Atlantic-facing coastline with productive rough ground; monitor swell, tide cut-offs and wind direction closely.

spots.name: Galley Head
spots.notes: Spinning from rocks for pollack and mackerel; float fishing for wrasse with crab or worm baits.

spots.name: Redstrand
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; surf conditions helpful
spots.notes: Surf fishing for flatfish, dogfish, mullet, gilthead bream and bass.

spots.name: Dunnycove Bay
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for flatfish, dogfish and bass. Distance casting can produce ray. Fishable at all stages of tide.

spots.name: Dunnycove North
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for flounder, dogfish and bass; spinning for pollack.

spots.name: Muckross Head
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for flounder and bass on last hour of ebb and first two hours of flood. Float fishing and spinning at high water.

spots.name: Muckross Estuary
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for flounder and bass. Early flood is best.

spots.name: Virgin Mary's Point
spots.notes: Bottom fishing, spinning and float fishing for bass and flounder; occasional gilthead bream. All stages of tide.

spots.name: Clonakilty Estuary Lower Channel
spots.notes: Bottom fishing; last of ebb and first two hours of flood are best.

spots.name: Clonakilty Estuary Inner Channel
spots.notes: Fish into the channel from early flood to high water. Crab is the best bait.

spots.name: Ring Harbour
spots.notes: Drift lining sandeel, crab or shrimp for bass; bottom fishing for flounder, bream, mullet and bass. Early flood and late ebb best.

spots.name: Bar Rock
spots.notes: Spinning and bottom fishing; last hour of ebb and first two hours of flood. Large bass have been recorded.

spots.name: Barry's Cove
spots.notes: Spinning and float fishing for pollack, mackerel and wrasse; bottom fishing for conger either side of beach.

spots.name: Barry's Point
spots.notes: Rock fishing for pollack, wrasse, mackerel and dogfish.

spots.name: Quarry Point
spots.notes: Rock fishing for pollack, wrasse, mackerel and dogfish.

spots.name: Broadstrand Bay
spots.notes: Beach fishing for bass and flounder.

spots.name: Land Point
spots.notes: Spinning for pollack, bass and mackerel; bottom fishing for dogfish.

spots.name: Courtmacsherry Strand
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; codling in winter on worm and crab baits
spots.notes: Beach fishing for bass, bream and flounder.

spots.name: Courtmacsherry Pier
spots.notes: Bottom fishing for conger, bass, mullet and flounder.

spots.name: School House Channel
spots.notes: Fish into the channel. Late ebb to early flood is best; specimen bass and flounder recorded.

spots.name: Timoleague
spots.type: River bridge, pool, quay and channel mark
spots.notes: Bottom fishing and driftlining for bass below Argideen River Bridge and in the channel. Two hours either side of high water best.

spots.name: Burren Pier
spots.notes: First three hours of flood best. Crab can be picked in weeds, but do not interfere with anglers' crab traps.

spots.name: Harbour View
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; codling possible in colder months
spots.notes: Spinning and bottom fishing from rocks over sand; bottom fishing for flounder.

spots.name: Kilbrittain Creek
spots.notes: Fish pools on either side of the road for flounder and mullet; spin in channel for seatrout and bass.

spots.name: Laherne Rocks
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; codling in winter
spots.notes: Float fishing on first two hours of flood for bass and wrasse. Danger of being cut off by rising tide.

spots.name: Garretstown Strand
spots.notes: Stretch beside Laherne Rocks is best. Good surf necessary; specimen flounder recorded.

spots.name: Orlaun Rock
spots.notes: Spinning for bass and seatrout. Dusk on a flooding tide is most productive.

spots.name: White Strand
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; good surf necessary
spots.notes: Surf fishing especially at the mouth of the stream.

spots.name: Old Head West - No Public Fishing Access
spots.type: No fishing / no public right of access
spots.notes: Provided information states no fishing and no public right of access at the Old Head.

spots.name: Old Head South - No Public Fishing Access
spots.type: No fishing / no public right of access
spots.notes: Provided information states no fishing and no public right of access at the Old Head.

spots.name: Old Head East - No Public Fishing Access
spots.type: No fishing / no public right of access
spots.notes: Provided information states no fishing and no public right of access at the Old Head.

spots.name: Sandy Cove
spots.notes: Fish from rock outcrops on southern shore over sand. Lugworm can be dug here.

spots.name: Old Bridge, Kinsale Area
spots.notes: Bottom fishing and driftlining for bass and flounder. Crab baits best; high water best.

spots.name: Gully Bridge
spots.type: Lagoon, river and tidal flow mark
spots.notes: Mullet in lagoon, flounder in main river, bass in tidal flow under road. Late ebb or early flood best.

spots.name: Jagoe's Point
spots.notes: Spinning for seatrout on ebb tide at dusk; bottom fishing for flounder and bass. Crab baits best.

spots.name: New Bridge
spots.seasons: Year-round; two hours either side of high water best
spots.notes: Fish into deep water at southern end of bridge.

spots.name: Middle Cove
spots.seasons: Spring to autumn; codling possible in colder months
spots.notes: Bottom fishing with fish baits best.

spots.name: Ballymacus Point
spots.seasons: Late spring to autumn; mackerel in season
spots.notes: Spinning for mackerel and pollack.
